text:
Priya (CS): Heads-up: HarborFin renewal demo in 5 days. They want a 1-page runbook for demo day: fast warmup, safe fallback, and a 2-question post-demo survey. Can eng/sre/solutions give a compact script we can send?

Tom (Eng): Keep it simple for customers: 1) Prefill 10-15m before demo with ~50 common prompts to seed KV cache. 2) Create transient warm pool sized to expected concurrency. 3) Add fallback routing to a quantized model. Prefill example (customer-facing):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"tenant_id":"harborfin-prod","prompts": ["account summary","card activity"]}'
```

Priya (CS): They expect ~120 concurrent demo flows. Any sizing tweaks? :thinking_face:

Eli (SRE): For 120 concurrent: warm_pool 4-5 per shard, batch_target 6. Short-lived alert rules during demo: queue_depth > 40 or p95_latency > 700ms. Bump autoscale ceiling x1.5 for the window. If fallback engaged, route 5% to primary for quality check.

Sara (Solutions): I'll own the smoke 24h prior (10 users emulating flows) and collect 8 sample prompts per demo path. Survey to embed after demo: Q1: Latency acceptable? (Yes/No). Q2: Any incorrect outputs? (optional). We'll log results to the account ticket.

infra-bot: deployment scheduled: warm-pool-tweak -> canary (id: c-4412). ETA 2m.

Tom (Eng): Quick note for runbook: how to trigger fallback (console -> routes -> enable fallback), sample YAML to share with customers: 
```yaml
warm_pool: 5
batch_target: 6
fallback_model: llm-small-8bit
```

Priya (CS): Action items: @Tom paste prefill script into the one-pager; @Eli add temporary alerts and autoscale bump; @Sara run smoke and send survey link. I'll confirm demo times with HarborFin PM and mark renewal risk=Monitor.

Eli (SRE): Staging dry-run shows cache_hit -> 74% after prefill, cached p95 ~120ms. I'll monitor during demo.

Priya (CS): Great — thanks all. I'll send the one-page runbook and close after smoke completes. :thumbsup:
